note: Council of Ministers communiqué of 18 September 2026 (Port-Gentil): local authorities appear in the decree approving the statutes of the Fonds de Péréquation des Collectivités Locales (an annual allocation of 5 to 10 per cent of the State's own resources), a toll to be co-managed by the Port-Gentil town hall, expropriations in the commune of Lastoursville and appointments (director-general of local authorities, secretary-general of the Libreville town hall); nothing on the connection, equipment or systems of any local government office.
